line.comment: * Bait and Rescue missions incur double penalty if its ship was claimed. Supply always incurs double penalty.
* -500 reputation and -1 Loyalty per penalty point.
* Loyalty Points are removed only if the player still has Loyalty.
* Don't use Mayhem.MissionEntry.Abort. Must properly remove the mission with Mayhem.Mission.Remove.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Added extra cleanup for additional missions besides rescue and police.
* Rescue: destroy passengers. JOO abandoned ship if it's unclaimed.
* Delivery: removes the delivery ship local variable, preventing it from updating a stale delivery mission. The delivery ship and pirate interceptors remain.
* Failure could be outside the player's control if a station is destroyed by other factors, hence keeping the delivery ship as a consolation prize.
* Patrol: JOO all spawned Xenon ships.
* Bait: JOO the bait ship if unclaimed and all spawned Kha'ak ships.
* Defense: JOO all spawned Xenon ships.
